test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 13 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Complete the sentence with the correct collocation.

Despite facing numerous challenges, Binod managed to attain an impressive level of academic ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**excellence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**excellence**" refers to the quality of being outstanding or extremely good.
 
• In this context, "academic excellence" signifies achieving a high standard in academic performance.
 
• The other options: "**result**," "**discourse**," and "**failure**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Despite facing numerous challenges, Binod managed to attain an impressive level of academic excellence__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Result**: Refers to the outcome or consequence of something but lacks the emphasis on quality in this context.
 
• **Discourse**: Refers to written or spoken communication, which does not fit the context of academic achievement.
 
• **Failure**: Refers to lack of success, which is the opposite of what is being conveyed here.
